committedBefore: any 2026-27 holdout evaluation of this challenger
kind: versioned challenger to the current props stats model (props-nb-minutes-rate-v1); shadow/offline only, never promoted by this change
whyThisImprovement: Calibration. The 2026-11-08 replay's learning layer put weight 0.50 on the stats model's points logit, i.e. the stats model is overconfident; the active model has no calibration of its own. Minutes uncertainty is already in the stats model's variance (rate^2 * sdMinutes^2), so it is not re-added. The existing learning challenger bundles calibration with matchup terms; this tests whether calibration alone explains its gain.
model: Per-stat Platt map on the stats model: logit P(More|no tie) = a_stat + b_stat * logit(stats P(More|no tie)); P(tie) carried unchanged. Expressed as a LearnArtifact with only 'bias' and 'stats_logit' weights (all other features fixed at zero), scored by the existing predictLearn.
primary: V2: map fit on the whole 2025-26 regular season (2025-10-21 .. 2026-04-13), layer 1 with 2024-25 priors and dispersion fit through 2025-12-31 (the existing replay pipeline), lambda chosen by the existing time-ordered validation.
comparisons: V1: same map fit on 2025-26 through 2025-12-31 only
V3: the existing matchup learning layer (props-learn design) refit on 2025-26 through 2025-12-31, market terms zero
B1: Poisson with the mean of the last 10 played games
B2: Poisson with the season-to-date mean
B3: share of the last 10 played games over the line, shrunk 50/50 toward 0.5
fitDataLabel: 2025-26 was inspected in earlier research (2026-11-07/08); results on it are exploratory, not confirmation.

holdout.data: SportsDataverse ESPN player_box_2027.csv (2026-27 regular season so far), pinned by SHA-256 in the report; never used for fitting or choosing anything
holdout.layer1: the production artifact src/data/props/model_v1.json exactly as the live worker scores (priors and dispersion frozen 2026-11-07)
holdout.lines: PROXY lines: floor(median of the last 10 played games) + 0.5, from earlier games only
holdout.scope: players who played (PrizePicks voids DNPs); at least 3 earlier played games this season

metrics: Brier (binary, no ties at half-point lines)
paired game-level bootstrap 95% interval of the Brier difference vs layer 1 (1,000 replicates, seed 20261110)
verdict: Improves on the holdout only if the primary variant's Brier upper 95% bound vs layer 1 is below 0 on at least two of three stats and it is not worse than V3 on any stat by more than 0.002. Otherwise: no improvement. Either way nothing is promoted; the live promotion gate is unchanged.
realLines: Captured PrizePicks/Pick6 lines are evaluated separately (read-only ledger audit in GitHub Actions): stats model vs props-cal-v1 vs timestamp-matched no-vig sportsbook probabilities at the exact same line; deduplicated across platforms by event|player|stat|line; game-level intervals. This sample is small and reported as descriptive only.
